line.comment: * Task 1329.
* Zero Hour 1.10
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: If insured (non-OCV ships built during the virus event), the base offset (variance) is reduced by 85% on hard (70% on insane).
* Never happens on easy/normal (negative events cannot occur with insurance policy); just in case.
* Hard: Reduces offset by 85%.
* Insane: Reduces offset by 70%.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Removed obsolete RNG workaround.
* Randomize infection timing by +/- the ship quality offset.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Duration reduced by 30% on insane.
* Final safety clamp: make sure it doesn’t go below 600 seconds, regardless of difficulty.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: A broadcast takeover forces this infection to mature.
* ZH 1.10 - Infected OCV ships immediately turn if ordered to attack Xenon or OCV targets.
* This does not apply to non-OCV ships infected by the Terraformer Virus event.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Attacking Xenon or OCV immediately matures the infection.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Non-OCV infected ships that were built during a terraformer virus event while the Outpost was insured will now show a (!) in the name. Checked once per minute.
* If the warning is not present (player renamed ship, fleet rename, etc.), then we append the warning.
* All OCV ship designs in the same sector are now also turning into OCV, including docked ships.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Collect OCV ship designs and any ships currently infected by the OCV virus.
* If the ship's current owner is OCV, then don't add to the ship to the list.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Never directly convert the current player ship.
* Mark its takeover as pending so its own virus task converts it once the player leaves.
* Convert everyone who qualifies, but only player-owned ships count toward player sacrifice, reputation loss, and notifications.
* [THIS] is converted below after all other affected ships are processed.
* Stop the ship's current command and OCV virus task before changing ownership.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Re-equip converted ships if they were stripped before takeover.
* Stop/remove non-converting ships from its fleet.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Never interrupt the current player ship.
* Ships that are also converting are handled separately.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: An infected ship cannot convert while it is the player ship.
* Keep the virus task alive and complete the takeover once the player leaves.
* If [THIS] was deferred because it was the player ship, account for it now.
* Turn [THIS] into OCV and start a team of invaders.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Re-equip this converted ship if [THIS] was stripped before takeover.
* Stop/remove non-converting ships from its fleet.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Never interrupt the current player ship.
* Ships that are also converting are handled separately.
* Add-Ons 1.4.21: Update progress when ships convert. The player must sacrifice 300 fleet power worth of infected ships to advance the plot.
